title: Vitamin A (retinol, beta-carotene)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin A (retinol, beta-carotene). Essential for vision (night vision and the visual cycle), immune defense, skin and mucous membrane health, and normal growth and reproduction.

title: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin C (ascorbic acid). Antioxidant protection, collagen formation for skin, blood vessels, and wound healing, iron absorption enhancement, and immune cell function.

title: Vitamin D (D2 ergocalciferol, D3 cholecalciferol)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin D (D2 ergocalciferol, D3 cholecalciferol). Calcium and phosphorus absorption for bones and teeth; muscle function; immune regulation; deficiency is linked to bone softening and higher fall risk.

title: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol). Fat-soluble antioxidant protecting cell membranes; supports immune function and healthy blood vessel lining.

title: Vitamin K (K1 phylloquinone, K2 menaquinones)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin K (K1 phylloquinone, K2 menaquinones). Blood clotting factor activation and bone protein regulation for bone mineralization.

title: Vitamin B1 (thiamine)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B1 (thiamine). Converts carbohydrates into energy; essential for nerve, muscle, and heart function.

title: Vitamin B2 (riboflavin)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B2 (riboflavin). Energy production from food; healthy skin, eyes, and red blood cell formation; helps activate other B vitamins.

title: Vitamin B3 (niacin)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B3 (niacin). Energy metabolism and DNA repair; high-dose nicotinic acid (prescription) lowers blood lipids.

title: Vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid). Builds coenzyme A for energy metabolism and the synthesis of hormones and cholesterol.

title: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine). Amino acid metabolism, neurotransmitter synthesis (serotonin, dopamine), hemoglobin formation, and immune function.

title: Vitamin B7 (biotin)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B7 (biotin). Metabolism of fats, carbohydrates, and proteins; supports healthy hair, skin, and nails.

title: Vitamin B9 (folate / folic acid)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B9 (folate / folic acid). DNA synthesis and cell division; red blood cell formation; prevents neural tube defects in early pregnancy.

title: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin)
description: Documented reference for Vitamin B12 (cobalamin). Red blood cell formation, nerve function, and DNA synthesis; works with folate.

title: Choline
description: Documented reference for Choline. Cell membrane structure, neurotransmitter (acetylcholine) synthesis, and liver fat metabolism; important in pregnancy for fetal brain development.
